description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing organization schedules, including endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting schedules associated with organizations and users.

classes.name: OrganizationsSchedulesController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling organization and user schedule management endpoints.

methods.name: getOrganizationSchedules
methods.description: Retrieves all schedules for a specific organization.

methods.name: createUserSchedule
methods.description: Creates a new schedule for a specific user within an organization.

methods.name: getUserSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves a specific schedule for a user.

methods.name: getUserSchedules
methods.description: Retrieves all schedules for a specific user.

methods.name: updateUserSchedule
methods.description: Updates a specific schedule for a user.

methods.name: deleteUserSchedule
methods.description: Deletes a specific schedule for a user.
